notes: The ASV's own gloss note (Greek the) corroborates that the supplied thy realizes τῆς; with no possessor expressed, rule 20's second arm gives the article the possessive and rule 21 lets the case preposition ride along. The same reading is taken for τῷ → to his.
τὸ … μέρος: the article precedes its expressed head noun, so it keeps the determiner however the intervening participle is rendered (rule 31).
